registry.description: Purity is the quality of being unmixed — single, uncontaminated, devoted to one thing without internal division or compromise. The Hebrew and Greek vocabulary covers both the ritual purity required for approach to God and the moral-inner purity that makes a person's motives and desires clean. Jesus radically internalises purity: blessed are the pure in heart. Purity of heart in the biblical sense is not innocence of experience but the absence of duplicity — wanting one thing, being directed toward one end.
